records.issue_text: packages/ui/components/form/inputs/Input.tsx:49 — tabIndex={-1} removes the password-visibility button from keyboard navigation across all PasswordField instances, preventing keyboard-only users from accessing it.
records.rationale: The diff at packages/ui/components/form/inputs/Input.tsx lines 47-51 shows the addition of `tabIndex={-1}` to the password visibility toggle button. This change is real and verifiable in the diff. The finding correctly identifies that tabIndex={-1} removes the element from keyboard tab navigation. Since PasswordField is a reusable component (as evidenced by its use in EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx in this same diff), this affects all instances. Keyboard-only users would be unable to toggle password visibility, which is an accessibility concern that constitutes a real defect.
